question: What are the 2026 freight rate statistics per lane? Show monthly trend Dec 2026-2027 with reasons and justification. Output a CSV table.

acceptance.expected: CSV table with monthly rate per lane, 2026 rate statistics, monthly trend Dec 2026-2027, reasons with justification

nodes.title: Asia-Europe lane rates
nodes.question: What are the monthly freight rates for Asia-Europe lane in 2026?

finding.answer: Asia-Europe rates ranged from 800 to 1200 per FEU in 2026.

claims.quote: December 2026 Asia-Europe spot rate reached 950 per FEU

sources.title: Asia-Europe Freight Rates 2026
sources.text: December 2026 Asia-Europe spot rate reached 950 per FEU. November 2026 rate was 920 per FEU. October 2026 rate was 890 per FEU.

nodes.title: Transpacific lane rates
nodes.question: What are the monthly freight rates for Transpacific lane in 2026?

finding.answer: Transpacific rates ranged from 1500 to 2500 per FEU in 2026.

claims.quote: December 2026 Transpacific rate reached 2100 per FEU
November 2026 Transpacific rate was 2000 per FEU

sources.title: Transpacific Freight Rates 2026
sources.text: December 2026 Transpacific rate reached 2100 per FEU. November 2026 Transpacific rate was 2000 per FEU. October 2026 rate was 1900 per FEU.
